policy_description.notes: DreamWAM released checkpoint through its own build_policy; the benchmark flips the images and DreamWAM center-crops, resizes and concatenates them inside predict_action, so this adapter applies no preprocessing of its own; note that the model seeds every sampling call from its own config, so repeats of one initial state are not independent samples
